summary: Between January 16 and 19, 2026 an unauthorized actor accessed and acquired files from limited systems of Safetyfirst Systems, a Parsippany, New Jersey driver and fleet safety services company. SFS found the suspicious activity through log review on January 19, contained it, and notified federal law enforcement. The files included names, Social Security numbers and driver's license numbers; notices went out in July 2026 without a stated count.
